speech.greeting: Good morning, {{name}}. Today is {{date}}. Here is what is happening on your farm today.

speech.ending: That is all for now. Press the button again anytime to listen again.
speech.unavailable: A voice for this language is not available on this device. I will try another voice.

speech.planAfterRain: wait until after Thursday’s rain, then check North Field soil
speech.leafReminder: River Bend soybean may have leaf spots. Review the photo check.
speech.waterReminder: Water North Field tomorrow. Check the soil first because it is getting dry.
speech.diagnosisAdvice: Remove badly affected leaves and avoid watering the leaves. Check again in three or four days.

diagnostics.intro: Take a clear photo of the affected leaf. We’ll check for common crop health signals and suggest what to do next.

diagnostics.tipSidesCopy: Include the leaf surface and underside.
diagnostics.tipCallout: Some symptoms look alike. Local expertise helps you choose the right next step.

diagnostics.apiLanguagesAvailable: The API supports English, Hindi, Portuguese and Chinese.
diagnostics.selectedLeafAlt: Selected crop leaf for disease analysis
diagnostics.orBrowse: or browse files from your device
diagnostics.fileLimit: JPG or PNG · up to 10 MB · Camera supported

diagnostics.uncertainCopy: Make sure the leaf is in focus and fills most of the frame.
diagnostics.noTreatment: No treatment details were returned for this result.
diagnostics.chooseFieldToSave: Choose a field to save this diagnosis
diagnostics.disclaimer: This result is for guidance. Confirm diagnoses with a local agronomist before treatment.

errors.badImage: The image could not be processed. Check that it is a clear JPG or PNG, then retry.
errors.imageTooLarge: This image is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller photo.
errors.unauthorized: Crop health access was denied. Please check the service configuration.
errors.notFound: Service endpoint not found. Check the server configuration and restart the dev server.
errors.rateLimit: The crop.health service has no available credits or is rate limited. Try again later or use the demo result.
errors.service: The crop.health service is having a problem. Please retry shortly or use the demo result.
errors.unexpected: The crop.health service returned an unexpected error. Please retry or use the demo result.
errors.unreadable: The crop.health service returned an unreadable response. Please retry or use the demo result.
errors.timeout: The photo check took too long. Please retry with a smaller or clearer image.
errors.connection: Could not reach crop.health. Check your connection and try again.
errors.failed: The photo check failed. Please try again.
